title: Patch: classify checks a change's card scripts five at a time, so a refactor across many scripts finishes inside CI's time limit
thread:
**Issue #4145 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4145: Patch: classify checks a change's card scripts five at a time, so a refactor across many scripts finishes inside CI's time limit
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Every pull request runs a check that works out which cards now play differently, so the patch notes and the card statistics restart for exactly those cards. When a change edits a card's code, the check proves whether that card really plays differently. It plays 40 games with the card on the new build and the same 40 on the old one, then compares them. That takes about 20 seconds a card, one card at a time. A clean-up that touches 17 cards' code without changing what they do spends almost six minutes proving nothing changed. One that touched 60 would use up the job's whole 20-minute limit and block the merge. Once this is built, the check puts five changed cards into the same 40 games, so a tidy-up costs about a fifth of the time. When a group's games do show a difference, its cards are checked one at a time as they are today, so a card that really changed is still caught and named. The maintainer and the bot will notice that big refactors stop timing out.

## Why
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:655-660`, the comment on the `rust-classify` job, says:
  - stage 2 plays `FORCED_GAMES` (40) games on both builds for each card script whose code a change touches, about 20 seconds a script on 4 cores;
  - so a refactor across 20 scripts runs past ten minutes;
  - #4090, a rename across 17 card scripts, had its classify step cancelled twice at 8m10s to 8m15s.
- The job's timeout is 20 minutes, and `rust (classify)` is part of the required `rust` check (`ci.yml:843`).
- `crates/tools/src/classify.rs:1095-1115` calls `forced_diverge` (lines 943-971) once per script, one after another. Each call runs one `record_seeds` of 40 games and starts one parent `golden check --file` process. A refactor diverges nowhere, so the `PATCH_MIN_CARDS` stop never comes and every script pays the full cost.
- R1365000 asks only that a card claimed through its script keeps the claim when its forced games show a divergence that touches it or touches no card. If a group of forced cards plays games that show no such divergence for any of them, that answers the question for all of them at once.

## Proposal
- Stage 2 splits the script-claimed cards it must check (after today's skips) into groups of `FORCED_GROUP_CARDS` (5, a named constant in `classify.rs`).
- It forces each group's cards into both decks of the same `FORCED_GAMES` seeds and runs one parent `golden check --file` per group. `record_seeds` already takes several ids, as `golden record --force` does.
- If none of a group's divergences touches one of its cards or touches no card, every card in the group is cleared.
- If a group has such a divergence, or the recorder or the parent cannot play it, each of its cards falls back to today's per-card `forced_diverge`. Those cards are then decided by their own 40 games exactly as now, and a card that cannot be forced still counts as changed.
- R3935001's steered subjects (`STEERED_GAMES`, the Walls) are never grouped.
- A change with a single script-claimed card plays exactly what it plays today.
- The `PATCH_MIN_CARDS` stop is checked between groups, as it is between scripts today.
- The loop moves behind a function that takes the 'do these forced games diverge for these cards' check as an argument, so tests can drive the grouping without a parent build.
- A new ruling in the issue's block amends R1365000 (grouped forcing with the per-card fallback). Its §11 paragraph goes in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, and a test is named after it.

Decisions taken here:
- Five cards a group, not ten. Ten forced cards would be two-fifths of a 25-card deck and would change what the games play.
- A group with a divergence falls back card by card rather than by halving. That is simpler, and such groups are uncommon, so it costs little.

## Where it lands
- `crates/tools/src/classify.rs`: stage 2's loop, the module header and the tests.
- `crates/tools/README.md`: the `classify` row.
- `spec/rulings/R<issue>000.md` and `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, amending R1365000. R3935001 is unchanged.
- The `rust-classify` comment in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (20 seconds a script) goes out of date until a person updates it. The bot leaves `.github/` alone.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Stage 2 forces script-claimed cards `FORCED_GROUP_CARDS` at a time, each card still in `FORCED_GAMES` games.
- [ ] A change with one such card records and checks exactly what it does today.
- [ ] Tests that use a stand-in check show:
  - a group of five with no divergence costs one check and clears all five;
  - a group with a divergence costs one check plus one per card, and keeps only the cards whose own games diverge;
  - a group the recorder refuses falls back per card, and a card that cannot be forced counts as changed;
  - the Walls are never grouped;
  - the `PATCH_MIN_CARDS` stop still marks the remaining cards `skipped`.
- [ ] The existing `r1365000_*`, `r3935001_*` and `r2173001_*` tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] The new ruling's test is named after it, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] The pull request reports stage 2's wall time before and after, for a code-only refactor of at least ten scripts, run with `classify --base … --parent-bin …` against the base's build.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` pass.

## Size and risks
Medium: about 150 to 250 lines in one file, plus a ruling note.

The risk is detection. A card cleared in a group was tested in 40 games shared with four other changed cards, not alone. It is still in both decks of all 40 games, and any group with a relevant divergence re-runs each card alone. So a real change is missed only if it shows in none of 40 shared games, which is the same kind of sample as today's 40 games.

A change that really alters several scripts pays for one extra group run (about 20 s) before the per-card runs. Balance passes mostly change catalog fields, and those cards skip stage 2 altogether (`classify.rs:1097`).

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44221944672)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Stage 2 of `cargo jackioh classify` forces script-claimed cards through their `FORCED_GAMES` (40) forced games in groups of five sharing one recorded run and one parent `golden check --file`, instead of one run per card. A group with no relevant divergence clears all its cards at once; a group with one, or one the recorder or parent cannot play, falls back to today's per-card `forced_diverge`, so a real change is still caught and named. A new ruling, R4145000, amends R1365000, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4145.md`.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/tools/src/classify.rs` | change | `FORCED_GROUP_CARDS` constant; shared forced-games core, `forced_group_diverge`, `check_scripts`; rewired `check()` script loop; module header; new `r4145000_*` tests |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | `classify` row: one sentence on grouped forcing |
| `spec/rulings/R4145000.md` | new | Ruling note amending R1365000 |
| `spec/pending/4145.md` | new | §11 paragraph for R4145000 |

Must not touch: `.github/` (the stale `rust-classify` comment in `ci.yml` is a person's update), `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`. Governing notes: R1365000 (forced-game confirmation), R3935001 (steered Walls, unchanged), R2173001 (tests must keep passing); `spec/README.md` ("Adding a ruling"); CLAUDE.md rules 3 (ruling + named test) and 9 (the new number is a named constant beside `FORCED_GAMES`).

## Steps

1. Re-read `spec/README.md` ("Adding a ruling"), `spec/rulings/R1365000.md`, `spec/rulings/R3935001.md`, and `crates/tools/src/classify.rs` lines 57–75, 926–971, 1083–1116. Confirm no `spec/rulings/R4145*.md` exists, so the ruling is R4145000.
2. In `crates/tools/src/classify.rs`, beside `FORCED_GAMES` (line 57), add `/// R4145000: … const FORCED_GROUP_CARDS: usize = 5;`.
3. Extract `forced_diverge`'s body (lines 943–971) into `fn forced_games_diverge(force: &[String], steer: &[String], watch: &BTreeSet<String>, head: &Side, parent: &Path) -> Result<bool>`, returning true when some divergence's `touched_by` set meets `watch` or is empty. Keep `forced_diverge(id, actors, head, parent)` with its exact signature; it builds `force = [id] + actors`, `steer = force` if actors else empty, `watch = {family(id)} + actor families`, and delegates. Copy the existing shape, do not redesign it.
4. Add `fn forced_group_diverge(ids: &[String], head: &Side, parent: &Path) -> Result<bool>`: `force = ids`, `steer = &[]`, `watch` = each id's `family`, delegating to `forced_games_diverge`. A one-card group therefore issues exactly today's record plus parent check.
5. Add `fn check_scripts(claims: &[String], play_len: usize, changed: &BTreeSet<String>, checked: &mut Checked, group: &mut dyn FnMut(&[String]) -> Result<bool>, solo: &mut dyn FnMut(&str, &[String]) -> Result<bool>)`. It walks `claims` in order: skip an id whose family is in `diff.play` or already in `checked.scripts`; before each solo card and each group run, test today's stop (`play_len + checked.scripts.len() + checked.touched.len() >= PATCH_MIN_CARDS || checked.rule`) and `skipped.insert(id)` for the rest when it holds. An id with non-empty `steered_with(id, changed)` goes solo immediately (Walls never grouped). Other ids accumulate; run `group` at every five and flush the remainder at the end. `Ok(false)` clears the group. `Ok(true)` or `Err` falls back card by card through `solo(id, &steered_with(id, changed))`; a `solo` `Err` keeps today's behavior exactly (`eprintln!("classify: {id} could not be forced ({e:#}); counted as changed")`, count as changed).
6. In `check()`, replace the loop at lines 1095–1115 with: `let claims: Vec<String> = diff.scripts.iter().cloned().collect();` (BTreeSet order, as today), the existing `changed` set kept as-is, two closures (`|ids| forced_group_diverge(ids, &after, parent)` and `|id, actors| forced_diverge(id, actors, &after, parent)`), then one `check_scripts` call with `play_len = diff.play.len()`. Leave the unforced-games and self-play sections untouched.
7. Update the module header's stage-2 paragraph (lines 18–22): after "diverge, so a refactor claims nothing;" insert "script-claimed cards share those games in groups of `FORCED_GROUP_CARDS`, each still in `FORCED_GAMES` games, and a group that diverges falls back card by card (R4145000);". In `crates/tools/README.md`'s `classify` row, replace "stage 2 confirms a script change by forced games" with "stage 2 confirms a script change by forced games shared in groups of `FORCED_GROUP_CARDS` (5), falling back card by card when a group diverges (R4145000)".
8. Write `spec/rulings/R4145000.md` (front matter `id: R4145000`, title naming grouped forcing amending R1365000 in issue #4145, `cards: "§9.4, R1365000, R3935001"`, `proven_in: [crates/tools/src/classify.rs]`): groups of five share one 40-game run and one parent check; cleared when no divergence touches a group card or touches no card; otherwise per-card fallback exactly as today, unforceable still counting as changed; steered subjects never grouped; single-card change plays what it plays today; rejected: groups of ten (two-fifths of a deck changes the games) and halving fallback (rarer, costlier to read).
9. Write `spec/pending/4145.md` with the one §11 paragraph, in the style of `spec/pending/4013.md`: `**[[R4145000]] … (issue #4145, 2026-11-18)**: …`.
10. Add the tests below, then run every command under Tests. For the PR description, time stage 2 before and after on one code-only refactor touching at least ten scripts: before = the base build's own `classify --base <rev> --parent-bin <base-bin>` (per-card logic), after = the new build on the same change and seeds; report both wall times.

## Tests

All in `crates/tools/src/classify.rs`, `mod tests`, driving `check_scripts` with scripted closures and a `Cell<usize>` call counter (no parent build). Each uses plain fake ids such as `core-001` (their `steered_with` is empty) except the Walls test.

- `r4145000_a_group_of_five_with_no_divergence_costs_one_check_and_clears_all_five`: group returns `Ok(false)`; assert one group call, zero solo calls, `checked.scripts` and `checked.skipped` empty.
- `r4145000_a_group_with_a_divergence_falls_back_card_by_card`: group returns `Ok(true)`; solo returns `Ok(true)` for one card, `Ok(false)` for the rest; assert 1 group + 5 solo calls and only that card's family in `checked.scripts`.
- `r4145000_a_group_the_recorder_refuses_falls_back_and_an_unforceable_card_counts_as_changed`: group returns `Err`; solo returns `Err` for one card, `Ok(false)` for the rest; assert 1 + 5 calls and only the refused card's family in `checked.scripts`.
- `r4145000_the_walls_are_never_grouped`: claims include `stinkyscapeplus-064` plus four plain cards with empty `changed`; group closure records its input; assert the Wall went through solo, and no group input ever contains it.
- `r4145000_the_patch_stop_still_marks_the_remaining_cards_skipped`: `play_len = 46`, six plain claims, group `Ok(true)`, solo `Ok(true)` for the first four of each group path and `Ok(false)` after; assert the last claim lands in `checked.skipped` with no further calls once the stop holds, mirroring `r1365000_what_the_check_stops_short_of_counts_unconfirmed`.

Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-tools classify`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo jackioh spec check`. Existing `r1365000_*`, `r3935001_*`, `r2173001_*` tests pass unchanged.

## Done when

- [ ] Stage 2 forces script-claimed cards five at a time, each card still in 40 games; one-card change plays what it does today.
- [ ] All five `r4145000_*` tests pass; existing `r1365000_*`, `r3935001_*`, `r2173001_*` tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] New ruling's test is named after it; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools`, clippy, and `cargo fmt --check` pass.
- [ ] PR reports stage-2 wall time before and after for a code-only refactor of at least ten scripts.
- [ ] No file outside the table changed; no check weakened.

## Risks

- Detection shift: a cleared card shared its 40 games with four others, but every card is in both decks of all 40 games and any relevant divergence re-runs each card alone; a real change is missed only if invisible in 40 shared games, the same sample as today's 40 solo games.
- Grouped forcing changes game texture (five forced cards a deck); the ruling records the rejected ten-card alternative and why.
- Extra cost when many scripts really change (one group run plus per-card runs); groups that diverge are uncommon and balance passes skip stage 2 via catalog fields.

## Open questions

None. Every choice the task left open (five cards, fallback rather than halving, Walls never grouped, injectable check for tests) is settled in the task's own decisions and proposal.
```
